inputs.original_text: Workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, calling for legally binding job security guarantees — even as the government argued it had already delivered on the most significant demands. inputs.modified_text: Support-programme workers at the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth took their dispute to the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, demanding legally binding job guarantees. The government says it has already met the most significant demands, so this now looks like a clash over assurances and leverage—not a reason to disrupt services families depend on. Job security matters, but it should be settled through responsible negotiation, not brinkmanship that puts stability in education at risk.
